adn_1214.t: Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan acknowledges President-elect Joe Biden's win — Anchorage Daily News (2020-12-14)

apm_jan4.t: Murkowski says she'll affirm Biden's win; Sullivan is mum — Alaska Public Media (2021-01-04)

checks.legal: CourtListener, Justia, Senate eFD, House/Senate Ethics, APOC and Alaska CourtView were all unreachable from this environment (proxy 403 / fetch provenance block), so no court or ethics database was searched directly. News searches (this pass: Senate Ethics complaint; earlier pass: lawsuits/charges) found no lawsuit, charge or Senate Ethics complaint against Sen. Dan S. Sullivan; the 2026 complaints found concern the other candidate, Dan J. Sullivan of Petersburg. Only compliance item remains the late STOCK Act reports (2018, 2022).
checks.foreign: Senate eFD unreachable; news coverage of his disclosures mentions no foreign assets. Exact-name check of the DOJ FARA bulk files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), searched 2026-10-13: no row names this candidate (the only near match is a 'Daniel J. Sullivan III' of SST Aerospace, Greenville SC, 2019 — a different person).
checks.claims: Mechanical sample: (a) every checkable claim on the campaign 'Meet Dan' page (dansullivanforalaska.com/meet-dan/): 11 rated (items on independent-voter share and his winning coalition are not checkable/opinion); (b) the first 10 items on the Issues page (first section 'Getting It Done in Washington'): intro claim (25 years/only serving senator) rated misleading, #8 ocean cleanup rated true, #5 judges unverifiable; #1 COVID, #2 ANWR/NPR-A, #3 '25% Obama cuts', #4 $300M water/sewer, #6 2A, #7 Green New Deal, #9 $50M public safety, #10 Alaska Native are opinion or were not checked. The Issues page appears to be largely 2020-era text. (c) Ad spend unknown; most-covered items: the campaign's 'pay raise' ad (FactCheck.org) and his Sept. 3, 2026 'zero bills' remarks. Also rated: his sham-candidate accusation against Dan J. Sullivan.
checks.democracy: Certification votes from senate.gov roll calls (records profile: Nay on the Arizona and Pennsylvania objections, 2021). Statements: ADN Dec. 14, 2020 (acknowledged Biden as president-elect); Alaska Public Media Jan. 4, 2021 reported he had not said in advance how he would vote. No 2024-result statement searched beyond this.

democracy.t: Voted against the objection to Arizona's electoral votes (objection failed 6–93).
Voted against the objection to Pennsylvania's electoral votes (failed 7–92).
Voted against creating an independent commission to investigate the Jan. 6 Capitol attack.

After the Electoral College vote, acknowledged Joe Biden as president-elect, saying his oath is to the Constitution and the laws of the nation, though the result was not what he and many Alaska Trump voters hoped for.

research_notes: Courts/ethics remain news-level because CourtListener, Justia and the Senate Ethics site were unreachable. Senate eFD still not read directly; money_history left at 'news' (FEC pages and super PAC funder pages could not be fetched).
